accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB (assumed; verify the entity's actual framework)

default_tax_line.label: Taxes
default_tax_line.basis: No safe generic default exists. Set forecast_assumptions.tax_pct_ebt explicitly to the entity's statutory or recent effective corporate income tax rate.

vat_note: If the entity operates under a VAT/GST regime, AR/AP balances may be VAT-inclusive while revenue/COGS are VAT-exclusive; working-capital day ratios then overstate days slightly. Model-level simplification.
fiscal_year_note: Template assumes annual periods of 365 days; align columns to the entity's fiscal year.
disclosure: Tax is modeled as a single effective rate applied to earnings before tax - a modeling simplification, not tax advice. Statement presentation follows a condensed management-account layout, not statutory IFRS presentation.
